grammar.title: Turning into with 把...V成
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 成 + 结果
grammar.explanation: Adding 成 (chéng) after the verb in a 把 sentence shows the object was changed into something new — "turn A into B". It's a common extension of the basic 把 structure for talking about transformations, exchanges, or writing something as something else.

grammar.title: Hastily, at once with 连忙
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 连忙 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 连忙 (liánmáng) means "hastily, at once" — describing a quick reaction to something that just happened. It goes right before the verb, often at the start of a response in a story.

sentences.zh: 他把钱都换成了人民币。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián dōu huàn chéng le rénmínbì.
sentences.en: He changed all the money into RMB.

sentences.zh: 他听到消息，连忙跑了过去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tīngdào xiāoxi, liánmáng pǎo le guòqù.
sentences.en: Hearing the news, he hurried over.

sentences.zh: 看见老师，他连忙站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: Kànjiàn lǎoshī, tā liánmáng zhàn le qǐlái.
sentences.en: Seeing the teacher, he hastily stood up.
